name: Serpent.
tag: C L A S S I C
description: The classic, in studio colours. Arrow keys or WASD. Eat, grow, don't fold in on yourself.

name: Reflex.
tag: R E A C T I O N
description: Thirty seconds, shrinking targets. Click them before they fade. How sharp are you today?

name: Rally.

description: First to seven against the house. The angles are yours to choose — the machine never blinks.

name: Pairs.
tag: M E M O R Y
description: Sixteen cards, eight pairs, one quiet test of recall. Fewer moves, better score.
